pairs.subject: cicd-monitoring
pairs.evidence: src/lib/integrations/providers.ts:26 The context's provider registry covers only AI-assistant usage and cost vendors (Claude Code OTel push, Copilot seats pull, OpenAI costs pull), so it never watches a pipeline it doesn't own. A search of src/lib/integrations, src/app/org/[slug]/integrations and src/app/api/integrations/ingest for workflow_run, pipeline, check_run, setInterval and rerun found nothing, which means the subject's observer-side precondition does not hold.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/integrations/providers.ts:25 Connectors either receive OTel pushes or pull usage on a schedule. There is no poll loop over live run or deploy state, and setInterval/poll do not appear in the context directories.
src/app/api/integrations/ingest/route.ts:1 Ingest stores usage records. No snapshots of pipeline status are taken, so there are no status transitions to diff or announce.

src/app/api/integrations/ingest/v1/logs/route.ts:19 The only logs here are Claude Code OTLP prompt/tool events, which are accepted and thrown away. There is no pipeline, stage, job or log-tail ladder.

src/lib/integrations/providers.ts:38 Each vendor gets an honest capability and fidelity declaration, but the vendors are AI-usage providers, not CI providers. There is no status vocabulary to map, so the technique as written does not apply.
